title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.16080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($\kappa_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $\kappa^2$ to $\kappa$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K

translated_title: DeepOHeat-v2：面向3D集成电路设计快速可信热优化的自改进算子学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16080v1 公告类型：新 摘要：多芯片三维集成电路的热感知优化需要评估许多设计，每次都需要求解成本高昂的热方程。算子学习代理模型用快速前向传播替代了这一求解过程，理想情况下仅从物理原理训练，无需标注数据。DeepOHeat-v1使此类代理模型快速且可信，但仅适用于低对比度几何结构。高对比度多芯片堆叠在两方面使其失效：不连续的热导率使得连续物理损失在材料界面处定义不当，以及病态条件（$\kappa_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$）使离散化强形式损失超出了一阶优化的能力。我们提出DeepOHeat-v2以克服这两个问题。首先，我们在离散化物理损失上训练，该损失天然处理不连续性；其能量形式将预测空间损失-海森矩阵条件数从$\kappa^2$降至$\kappa$，且矩阵预条件优化器将平均峰值温度误差从超过30K降低。
tldr: DeepOHeat-v2通过离散化物理损失和矩阵预条件优化，解决了高对比度3D集成电路热优化中不连续性和病态条件问题，实现了快速且可信的热预测。
en_tdlr: DeepOHeat-v2 overcomes discontinuity and ill-conditioning issues in high-contrast 3D-IC thermal optimization via discretized physics loss and matrix-preconditioned optimization, enabling fast and trustworthy thermal prediction.
